failed to create the sampler; sampling not done

This is telling you that you have an error at line 21. It should be this line:
  for(i in 1:N_obs) x[i]<- x_obs[i];

It helps to put your Stan program into a separate file so you can easily track line numbers.

I'm guessing that x[i] and x_obs[i] are different sizes, but I don't know why it'd give you that message. I'll try to hunt it down what that message means.

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Stan Errors
parts:
Ah. It's making sense now. I don't know if there's a better way to form that error message.

Stan is an imperative language (it executes things in the order you write it).

If you look at the transformed data block:
transformed data{
  int<lower=1> N;
  row_vector[D] x[N];
  matrix [N,D] x_mat;
  vector[N] mu;
  N<- N_obs + N_pred;
  ...

you are trying to declare x as: row_vector[D] x[N]. Here, N is still 0. It only gets set to N_obs + N_pred after x is declared.

One way to fix it is to declare x as:
  row_vector[D] x[N_obs + N_pred];


With that fix, you'll run into problems for x_mat and mu, but I'll let you take care of that.



Daniel
